26425.overview: Have you ever dreamed of walking on a magnificent world with the feeling that nothing can stop you because of your power, of what you are? You are the young and mighty god of thunder and the fate of the universe is in your hand. Yggdrasil, the world tree, is dying. The three Norns, Skuld, Urd and Verdandi are missing and no one is tending the world tree.

127440.overview: This cooking game requires you to prepare food for a few diverse diners, from vampires, mafia, vikings and more. The player must prepare dishes as quickly as possible to avoid customers getting tired and leaving without giving a tip.

128031.overview:
Yeti and Pengu are back! For the first time, this mismatched couple is taking off on the PSP system. After being smashed around for years Pengu finally gets to fly!

In 'Level Mode' use the X button to get Pengu to jump from the cliff top and time Yeti's swipe of the bat to launch him in the air. Fly Pengu with the directional buttons, analog stick or L button and the R button and guide him through 27 stages of all new level gameplay. Chase the Albatrosses to steal their fish or swoop low over the ice to pluck your catch and boost your score. Do you have what it takes to get you name in the High-score table?!

There is also 'Classic Mode' where your goal is to get Pengu to glide further than any other penguin has ever done.
